name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 8 points on PVI
Dean holds a massive fundraising edge ($1.2M cash vs $4K)
Polymarket prices Dean at 97% to win
Challenger Stuski is underfunded and unknown
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Dean: a D+8 district, incumbency, and a fundraising advantage of more than a hundred to one, with markets pricing her at 97%. No polls or expert ratings exist, but nothing in the evidence suggests movement away from a Safe D call.
model.watch: A major outside spending surge for Stuski or a sharply unfavorable national environment could narrow the margin, though not enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks a fifth term in a Montgomery County-based district that leans Democratic by eight points. She has raised $1.37 million and holds $1.18 million on hand, while Republican Aurora Stuski has raised under $9,000, leaving her with essentially no resources to compete. No outside groups are opposing Dean, and prediction markets give her a 97 percent chance of winning.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and market pricing. All point the same direction: a comfortable Democratic win with a margin near twenty points.
